name: Metroid: ENF
source: Bounty hunter Samus Aran receives a request from the Galactic Federation to investigate a distress signal from an abandoned research facility on Planet XR-699, and is in return promised a pardon for her insubordination when she eliminated the X parasites during the events of Metroid Fusion.
